shots.shot_type_other: 3D plush mascot riding a 3D knight piece composited over a recreated app course-picker UI
shots.focal_element: Oscar (mustached plush mascot) riding a large black knight piece across the course picker
shots.transition_other: very short motion-blurred interstitial; keyframe shows the course picker smeared vertically with a green bar sweeping in at the bottom
shots.typography: App UI labels: bold rounded geometric sans, title case, normal tracking (low-confidence guess: DIN Next Rounded); stat counters in bold rounded numerals coloured per icon. The streak/XP counter next to the chess icon and the 'French' label are occluded by the character.
shots.what_happens: A ~0.4 s bridge shot: the recreated Duolingo course picker (Chess selected, French, German) is shown while Oscar on a black knight bounds over it, closing out 'basic moves' (w33); heavy motion blur suggests a fast camera move into s020.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a flat course-picker card row at 1280x720, overlay a transparent-background 3D character-on-knight render with a soft drop shadow, and drive a 0.4 s vertical motion-blur translate as the entry.

shots.shot_type_other: 3D plush mascot riding a 3D knight piece composited over a recreated app course-picker UI
shots.focal_element: Oscar riding the black knight piece, which hops in an L-shape across the course tiles
shots.transition_other: continuation of the motion-blurred move from s019 settling onto the course picker
shots.typography: Recreated app UI: bold rounded sans labels in title case, dark grey; stat counters bold rounded numerals (low-confidence guess: DIN Next Rounded). No overlay headline.
shots.what_happens: On 'Giddy up.' (w34-w35) Oscar rides the knight across the Chess/French/German tiles; the knight hops from left to right, Oscar is thrown off and tumbles mid-air, ending motion-blurred over the French tile while a dark shape enters at the right edge (likely the next transition).
shots.build_rebuild: Keep the course-picker UI static and animate a pre-rendered 3D knight-plus-rider sprite along a hop arc (translate + rotate with ease-out on landing), then detach the rider sprite and spin it off with motion blur over ~0.5 s.

shots.focal_element: Oscar seated on a gilded red throne as a crown drops onto his head
shots.what_happens: Hard cut to a low, dutch-angled 3D shot of Oscar on a gold throne against flat pink; yellow comic-burst rays flash behind him as a red crown lands on his head (aligned with the whoosh x014 and impact x015), then the rays vanish, leaving pink; VO 'Already a king of the board?' (w36-w41).
shots.build_rebuild: Render a tilted low-angle 3D character on a throne over a flat pink plate, drop a crown model onto the head with a quick ease-in and slight squash on contact, and flash a yellow starburst shape layer behind for ~0.5 s around the impact frame.

shots.focal_element: Top-down gold-framed chessboard with a knight and its L-shaped move arrow
shots.typography: Chunky heavy rounded sans, italic/slanted, all caps, tight tracking, white fill with thick teal outline stroke (low-confidence guess: Feather Bold); pops in centred over the board.
shots.what_happens: The camera zooms through to a rotated, motion-blurred overhead view of a light-grey chessboard in an ornate gold frame on pink; the board rotates level while a knight with an L-shaped arrow, a rook and Oscar (as the throned king) are shown; 'ADVANCED TACTICS' pops in on 'advanced tactics' (w45-w46) then the camera pushes closer.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a flat checkerboard plane with a gold frame on pink, animate camera rotation from about -20 degrees to 0 with a scale push and motion blur over 0.6 s, draw an elbow arrow from the knight, and pop in an outlined all-caps label with scale overshoot.

shots.focal_element: The knight piece next to Oscar's throne on the close top-down board
shots.typography: Same outlined heavy italic all-caps label style as s022, appearing small at the end of the shot as part of the incoming panel.
shots.what_happens: Closer overhead board: the knight hops next to Oscar's throne ('Fork, baby.', w47-w48), then jumps onto the rook's square ('Fork.', w49) and Oscar's throne topples over; at the very end a green panel carrying 'THOUSANDS OF PUZZLES' begins rising from the bottom. The exact capture sequence is inferred from 2 fps frames.
shots.build_rebuild: Animate a knight sprite across the grid in two snappy L-hops (ease-out, ~0.25 s each) with contact shadows, then rotate the throne model 90 degrees as if knocked over while a green card translates up from below frame.

shots.shot_type_other: white-outlined plush mascot cutout and puzzle-board cards over a flat green motion-graphics panel
shots.focal_element: 'THOUSANDS OF PUZZLES' headline with Oscar's cutout popping up from below
shots.transition_other: green panel slides up over the chessboard (wipe-like panel cover)
shots.typography: Heavy rounded italic all-caps headline, tight tracking, white fill with thick dark-teal outline (low-confidence guess: Feather Bold), centred near the top.
shots.what_happens: A ~0.3 s shot: the green panel covers the board and a motion-blurred Oscar cutout with white sticker outline pops up from the bottom; by 29.0 s a pink rectangle frame and stacked mini puzzle-board cards fly in, partly covering the headline, leading into the puzzles beat.
shots.build_rebuild: Slide a full-width green panel up over the previous scene, pop a white-stroked character cutout up from the bottom edge with motion blur, and fly stacked mini board cards in from the left over the outlined headline.
